name: Grumman F4F / FM-2 Wildcat
summary: Stubby carrier fighter that held the line in the early Pacific war; the GM-built FM-2 with a tall tail is the version most seen flying today.

wings: Mid-mounted straight wing with squared tips
Wings that fold along the fuselage for carrier storage
engines: Single radial engine in a round cowl with a three-blade propeller
fuselage: Narrow-track main gear that folds into the fuselage
tail: Tall, squarish fin on the FM-2
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Short, chubby barrel fuselage with a mid-wing and a round radial nose
Tall squarish fin on a small single-seat carrier fighter
Narrow gear that folds into the fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Corsair is a bigger fighter with an inverted gull wing and a long nose; the Wildcat is shorter with straight wings.
The Bearcat has a low wing, a long cowl and a tall tail; the Wildcat is stubbier with a mid wing.
The P-40 has an inline engine with a radiator scoop under the nose; the Wildcat has a round radial.
The Avenger is a larger three-seat bomber with a bulbous body; the Wildcat is a small single-seat fighter.
